specs.goal: Verdict and integration run on the VM as ga-engine code, and the accept/integrate decision never depends on an LLM.
specs.why: User 10-06 23:0x: go with R3 on the VM; verdict and integration must not depend on LLM performance.
acceptance: the decision to integrate is a pure function of executable checks: head==sha, ancestry, allowed files, acceptance test identical and red on base, full suite green in the reference environment, generated mutations all killed (or cross-covered by the full suite), revert makes the test fail
mutations are generated from the diff by code (no model)
no model call anywhere on the verdict or integration path; a test fails if one is added
criteria that cannot be executed never lead to integration: the item stays in shadow and is reported
the VM performs the push itself under a policy the user approves once; ff or merge commit to the one integration ref only, never force
same input gives the same verdict (deterministic, replayable from the recorded inputs)
constraints: spec only: Dev decides method and plan

specs.goal: Token and context watching runs on the VM as ga-engine code with no model call, and replaces the Claude watcher session.
specs.why: User 10-06 23:2x: watching rules as VM code; an independent check outside the Claude sessions it measures.
acceptance: reads the published session snapshot (baseline ops/hub/cloud_sessions.json: per-session ctx, cost, status) and the ga ledgers; no Claude credentials on the VM
alarms by fixed rules: ctx over the cap on a non-completed session, one session's cost rising faster than a set rate, total cost rising faster than a set rate, snapshot older than a set age
thresholds come from a config file Ops owns; defaults: ctx 150000, 5 USD/h per session, 12 USD/h total, snapshot 2 h
each alarm is mailed once per kind per session per day as notify/1 kind alert to baseline-ops; a stale snapshot alarm also reaches the user
no model call on this path (a test fails if one is added); deterministic for the same inputs
constraints: spec only: Dev decides method and plan

specs.goal: The VM watcher uses the Ops thresholds file as its only source of threshold values.
acceptance: values read from baseline ops/hub/watch_thresholds.json (ctx_cap_tokens 150000, session_usd_per_h 5, total_usd_per_h 12, snapshot_max_age_h 2)
a change committed to that file takes effect without a code change
snapshot source is ops/hub/cloud_sessions.json, published by Ops at least hourly
constraints: values are Ops's; method is Dev's

why: DEV-WATCH (+ its limits) and DEV-R3-DET are independent; run in parallel if capacity allows, else DEV-WATCH first (small, retires an always-on Claude session after Ops's 24 h side-by-side). Release each as release/1 to Ops; Ops verifies on the VM (notify-1 version, alarms vs Claude watcher for 24 h; R3-DET by replayed verdicts over past branches).
